summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GenLeadAI white+purple theme redesign. All major features tested including login, dashboard, lead management, pipeline, analytics, ARIA agent, and settings. Theme implementation is excellent with consistent white backgrounds and purple accents throughout.

Dashboard shows white sidebar with purple active state on Dashboard nav item
Dashboard KPI cards have white background with purple shadows/accents
Dashboard charts render with purple color scheme (#7C35DC)
Lead Inbox table loads with white bg and purple header row (rgb(244, 240, 255))
Lead Inbox search and filter controls work with new styling
Add Lead modal opens with white theme
Pipeline Kanban cards have white bg with purple accents and B2B/B2C toggle
Analytics charts use purple color palette with 12 SVG charts rendered
